caption: Basiliek, Sint Odiliënberg
composition: Romanesque basilica with two choir towers on the church hill · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The basilica at Sint Odiliënberg is a Romanesque church of fieldstone, tuff, and sandstone on the hill by the Roer. Two square choir towers flank a lower polygonal choir. The towers were blown up in 1945 and reconstructed in 1949-1951, so the present towers are shown, not a ruin. It is mainly clear, about 7.6°C, with wind near 6.5 km/h and cloud cover about 20%. The church is closed. The small chapel beside the hill is not the subject.
